title: Russia has released detained American teacher Marc Fogel, the White House says
description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Marc Fogel, an American teacher who was deemed wrongfully detained in Russia , has been released in what the White House described as a diplomatic thaw that could advance negotiations to end the war in Ukraine.
